{{Current events|year=2026|month=06|day=19|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2025–2026 Iran–United States negotiations]]
****The [[Federal Department of Foreign Affairs|Swiss foreign ministry]] confirms that the planned talks between [[Iran]] and the [[United States]] at the [[Bürgenstock Resort]], [[Switzerland]], have been cancelled after [[Vice President of the United States|U.S. vice president]] [[JD Vance]] cancelled his trip. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/us-iran-peace-talks-geneva-called-off-clouding-prospects-lasting-truce-2026-06-19/ (Reuters)]
***[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
****[[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Iran)|Iranian foreign ministry]] [[Spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Iran|spokesperson]] [[Esmail Baghaei]] rejects reports that [[Iran]] has re-closed the [[Strait of Hormuz]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/2009247 (''Dawn'')] [https://www.euronews.com/2026/06/19/confusion-in-strait-of-hormuz-amid-reports-iran-has-reclosed-the-waterway (Euronews)]
**[[2026 Lebanon war]]
***At least 47 people are killed and 97 more injured by [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s across [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/us-iran-talks-postponed-vance-cancels-trip-israel-strikes-lebanon-rcna350830 (NBC News)]
***The United States announces that Israel and [[Hezbollah]] agreed to a [[ceasefire]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/us-iran-talks-postponed-vance-cancels-trip-israel-strikes-lebanon-rcna350830 (NBC News)]
***Four [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] are killed in a [[shootout]] with Hezbollah fighters near [[Nabatieh]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/19/iran-war-live-jd-vance-defends-iran-deal-as-us-says-naval-blockade-lifted?update=4677914 (Al Jazeera)]
***Lebanese [[Conservation movement|conservationist]] and environmentalist [[Mona Khalil]], a advocate for the protection of endangered [[sea turtle]]s, dies from wounds sustained during an Israeli attack in [[southern Lebanon]] two weeks ago. [https://www.newarab.com/news/lebanon-sea-turtle-protector-dies-wounds-israeli-strike (''The New Arab'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***The [[Sudan]]ese [[Human rights group|human rights organization]] Emergency Lawyers reports that nine civilians have been killed in a [[Rapid Support Forces]] (RSF) drone strike on a passenger vehicle carrying civilians in [[North Darfur]]. Additionally, another drone struck the Um Bayada market, causing a massive [[fire]]. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20260619-rsf-drone-strike-kills-9-civilians-in-north-darfur-report/ (Middle East Monitor)] [https://darfur24.com/en/2026/06/19/nine-killed-12-injured-in-drone-strike-on-civilian-vehicle-in-north-darfurs-al-malha/ (Darfur24)]
**[[Kordofan campaign (2023–present)|Kordofan campaign]]
***The [[Secretary-General of the United Nations|UN secretary general]] envoy to [[Sudan]] calls for RSF head [[Hemedti|Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo]] to halt attacks on the [[North Kordofan]] area of [[El-Obeid]]. [https://www.arabnews.pk/node/2647897/sport (AFP via ''Arab News PK'')]
***Rapid Support Forces launch a drone strike on the [[El-Obeid]] area of [[North Kordofan]], Sudan, amidst warnings about the situation in the area. [https://sudantribune.com/article/315248 (''Sudan Tribune'')]
***[[Catholic Church|Catholic]] [[priest]] Yohanna Al-Amin Komkome is killed alongside two of his associates in [[Kauda, Sudan|Kauda]] near the [[Nuba Mountains]]. The [[Sudan People's Liberation Movement–North]] is accused of the attacks. [https://en.sudannow.net/catholic-priest-killed-in-kauda-amid-accusations-against-splm-n-faction/ (Sudan Now)] 
*[[Terrorism in the United Kingdom]]
**[[2026 Edinburgh attacks]]
***Five people are injured in [[Islamophobia|Islamophobic]] attacks in [[Edinburgh]], [[Scotland]]. A 36-year-old man is arrested and counter-terrorism police are investigating. [https://www.dw.com/en/terror-police-probe-suspected-anti-muslim-attacks-in-edinburgh/a-77639385 (DW)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Mexico|Mexican]] [[archaeologists]] uncover [[Classical antiquity|Early Classic]]-period ruins in [[Veracruz]] featuring a circular stone platform and other previously undocumented [[Classical architecture|architectural elements]] for the region. Researchers also discover a carved [[monolith]] depicting figures with possible [[Maya civilization|Maya]] cultural influences. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260620-archaeologists-discover-never-before-seen-pre-hispanic-ruins-in-mexico (AFP via France 24)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war]]
**[[2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis]]
***Iran's [[Persian Gulf Strait Authority]] states that [[tariff]]s and insurance will not be collected from ship owners during the 60-day period of the [[Islamabad Memorandum]]. However, it also calls for ships to register with it, and requires that a transit request for the [[Strait of Hormuz]] must be made 48 hours prior to arrival. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-us-israel-lebanon-oil-june-19-2026-635ad6f41610df8355d24cc301a75fc4 (AP)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/world/iran/us-iran-talks-postponed-vance-cancels-trip-israel-strikes-lebanon-rcna350830 (NBC News)]
* The [[government of Japan]] revises a [[Cabinet of Japan|Cabinet]] order on visa fees, where issuance fees for foreigners entering [[Japan]] will increase fivefold, effective on July 1; the first since 1978. [https://globalnation.inquirer.net/327901/japan-foreigner-entry-visa-fees-to-be-hiked-5-fold-to-15000-yen (Kyodo News via ''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')] [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/world/2026/6/22/japan-to-raise-visa-fees-for-foreigners-5-fold-starting-july-1223 (ABS-CBN News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Bedford train collision]]
**One person is killed and 89 others are injured, including 33 seriously with nine in [[Medical state|critical condition]], after two [[passenger train]]s [[Railway accident|collide]] near [[Bedford]], [[Bedfordshire]], [[England]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/cy8dy2pr8ymt (BBC News)] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2026/06/19/two-emr-trains-collide-near-bedford/ (''The Daily Telegraph'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cy8dy2pr8ymt (BBC News)]
*The [[Huisekoutermolen]] windmill in [[East Flanders]], [[Belgium]], is blown down in a thunderstorm. [https://www.brusselstimes.com/2200979/historic-windmill-torn-down-by-gale-force-winds-in-kruisem (''The Brussels Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Philippines–Russia relations]]
**[[President of the Philippines|Philippine president]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] announces that 24 [[Overseas Filipinos|Filipino nationals]] detained in [[Russia]] will be released and repatriated to the [[Philippines]] following a meeting with [[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] in [[Kazan]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/russia-frees-24-filipinos-after-prime-minister-marcos-talks-with-putin/ (AP via CBS News)]
*[[Poland–Ukraine relations]]
**[[President of Poland| Polish president]] [[Karol Nawrocki]] strips [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[President of Ukraine|president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] of [[Poland|the country]]'s highest honour, the [[Order of the White Eagle (Poland)|Order of the White Eagle]], for naming an army unit after the [[Ukrainian Insurgent Army]], which [[Massacres of Poles in Volhynia and Eastern Galicia|massacred Poles]] during [[World War II]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/polish-president-decides-strip-ukraines-zelenskiy-top-honour-over-ww2-dispute-2026-06-19/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Organised crime in Australia]]
**The [[Australian Federal Police]] seizes 2.7 tonnes of [[cocaine]] concealed in underground storage containers in [[Sydney]], the largest cocaine seizure in [[Australia|the country]]'s history. Authorities arrest two people at the site and charge them with offenses related to importing and [[Illicit drug use in Australia|possessing illicit drugs]]. [https://www.abs-cbn.com/news/world/2026/6/22/australian-police-seize-record-2-7-tons-of-cocaine-0819 (AFP via ABS-CBN News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/police-seize-572-million-cocaine-australias-biggest-haul-2026-06-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Hijab in Iran]]
**Iranian singer [[Parastoo Ahmadi]] is sentenced by a criminal court to 74 lashes after performing at a concert in 2024 without the use of the [[hijab]]. Additionally, she is also banned from performing or leaving the country for two years. [https://www.euronews.com/culture/2026/06/19/iranian-artist-parastoo-ahmadi-reportedly-sentenced-to-74-lashes-for-singing-without-hijab (Euronews)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/23/world/middleeast/iranian-singer-lashing-sentence.html (''The New York Times'')]
*The [[Australian Government]] agrees to pay [[A$]]28 million ([[US$]]20 million) in a [[Settlement (litigation)|settlement]] with 38 former [[Asylum seekers in Australia|asylum seekers]] who alleged [[Immigrant health in Australia|harm]] while detained at the [[Baxter Immigration Reception and Processing Centre|Baxter]] and [[Woomera Immigration Reception and Processing Centre|Woomera]] [[Australian immigration detention facilities|immigration detention centres]]. The agreement follows a [[High Court of Australia|High Court]] ruling on compensation claims for [[Immigration detention in Australia|unlawful detention]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2026/06/20/world/australia-to-pay-20m-in-compensation-to-asylum-seekers-detained-in-desert/2369224 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
*[[Costa Rica]]n [[Public Force of Costa Rica|police]] arrest a man in connection with an alleged threat against [[President of Costa Rica|president]] [[Laura Fernández Delgado]]. The president is evacuated during a visit to northern Costa Rica after an explosion was reported nearby. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/costa-rica-arrests-man-over-suspected-death-threat-president-2026-06-20/ (Reuters)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Bolivian protests]]
**[[Bolivia]]n [[President of Bolivia|president]] [[Rodrigo Paz]] and the Bolivian Workers' Confederation [[trade union]] reach an agreement aimed at easing a 50-day protest crisis marked by [[road blockade]]s and supply shortages. Other protest groups continue demonstrations and demand Paz's resignation. [https://www.reuters.com/3fec1b0a85a0/world/americas/bolivia-signs-deal-with-cob-labor-union-after-50-days-anti-govt-protests-2026-06-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Labour Party leadership crisis]]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] [[home secretary]] [[Shabana Mahmood]], [[Secretary of State for Energy Security and Net Zero|energy secretary]] [[Ed Miliband]], and [[Secretary of State for Transport|transport secretary]] [[Heidi Alexander]] meet with [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|prime minister]] [[Keir Starmer]] and reportedly urge him to set out a timetable for his departure following [[Andy Burnham]]'s win in the [[2026 Makerfield by-election]]. [https://www.heraldscotland.com/news/26211432.ed-miliband-tells-starmer-set-departure-timeline-post-burnham-win/ (''The Herald'')] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/politics/2026/06/19/makerfield-by-election-live-burnham-starmer-labour-reform/ (''The Telegraph'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[AI boom]], [[Regulation of artificial intelligence]]
**[[Norway|Norwegian]] [[Prime Minister of Norway|prime minister]] [[Jonas Gahr Støre]] announces new [[Education in Norway|school]] guidelines that generally prohibit the use of [[generative AI]] by [[primary school]] pupils and restrict its use for older students. The policy takes effect in the next academic year. [https://www.reuters.com/technology/norway-imposes-near-ban-ai-elementary-school-2026-06-19/ (Reuters)]
*[[Malaysia]]n [[Science and technology in Malaysia|researchers]] identify ''Pleurocordyceps cornusynnemata'', a new [[Fungus|fungal]] species in [[Borneo]] that [[Parasitism|parasitizes]] ''[[Ophiocordyceps]]'' fungi infecting ants. Scientists also report the discovery of a previously undocumented spider-infecting fungus. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/parasite-zombie-fungus-malaysia-borneo-discovery/ (AFP via CBS News)]

'''Sports'''
*[[TYR Pro Swim Series]]
**In [[swimming]], [[Swimming in the United States|American swimmer]] [[Kate Douglass]] sets a [[World record progression 50 metres freestyle|world record]] in the women's 50-meter [[Freestyle swimming|freestyle]] at the Pro Swim Series in [[Indianapolis]], finishing in 23.59 seconds and surpassing the previous mark of 23.61 seconds set by [[Swimming in Sweden|Sweden]]'s [[Sarah Sjöström]]. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/sports/20260619-douglass-breaks-50m-free-world-record-at-indy-pro-swim (AFP via RFI)]

<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
